The articles specifically listed in "Annex A" hereof, as
classified under Section 104 of the Tariff and Customs Code of 1g7g, as
amended, shall be subject to the rates of import duty in accordance with the
schedule indicated opposite each article.

The Nomenclature and the rates of import duty on tariff
headings not enumerated and those listed but represented ny ine symbol ,,x x x
,,
shall remain in force and effect.

Upon the effectivity of the Executive Order, the articles
specifically listed in the aforesaid "Annex" which are entered in or withdrawn from
warehouses in the Philippines for consumption shall be levied the rates of duty
herein prescribed.

All other Presidential issuances, administrative rules and
regulations, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are
hereby revoked or modified accordingly.
